title: Bank of Baroda (BOB) Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer LBO Posts
shortInfo: Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced notification for Local Bank Officer LBO posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any discipline, 1 year experience. Last date to apply: 07-09-26.

fees.fee: Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (ESM/DESM) / Women candidates
fees.fee: Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.

title: Sikkim Education Department Recruitment 2026 – STET Posts
shortInfo: Sikkim Education Department has announced notification for STET posts. Required qualification: Other. Last date to apply: 12-09-26.

title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate Degree / Diploma / ITI. Last date to apply: Update.
howToApply: Graduate/Diploma candidates must register on the NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to your preferred location.
Submit the online application through the respective portal.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.

title: SPSC Recruitment 2026 – Village Level Workers (VLW) Posts
shortInfo: SPSC has announced notification for Village Level Workers (VLW) posts. Required qualification: B.Sc. Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture. Last date to apply: 31-08-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website of Sikkim Public Service Commission at www.spsc.sikkim.gov.in
Find and click on the relevant advertisement for Village Level Workers (VLW) posts.
Register/Login to fill the online application form.
Fill in all required personal, educational, and other details accurately.
Upload required documents as specified.
Submit the application form online before the last date.
Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
